## About
Triple F Automotive is a full service automotive sales, parts, service and restoration facility dedicated to the preservation of automotive history. Our approach starts simple: we totally dismantle your vehicle, then hunt down the pieces that are factory replacement or era correct.
The work runs from fiberglass repairs and chemical stripping to fabrication, upholstered interiors and modern components for your classic. If you'd rather buy ready to roll, the showroom carries American Muscle, Classics, Street Rods and select Classic Imports, and the classic parts department can help with your own build.
Customers have rated us 4.7 from 75 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Doug and Denise by name.

## Services
- Fiberglass Repairs: Corvettes, cobra and kit cars, minor to major. Front ends installed, panels replaced, and fiberglass re-gelcoated to factory specs before body work begins. The shop has 27 years of fiberglass experience.
- Paint Booth: Large 50 foot down draft booths with bake capabilities let us paint the whole car at one time for a consistent color match.
- Blasting booth: Removes rust, paint and caulk from body panels, frames and suspension parts. Panels are chemically stripped first so only structural parts get blasted.
- Fabrication: We cut out rust areas, panels, floors and quarters, then replace or create what's needed with plasma, English wheel, planishing hammer, power bead roller and mig welding.
- Upholstered interiors: Cloth, leather or exotic materials, from a full custom build to simple repairs.
- Modern components: Modern engine, transmission and disc brakes for your classic rod, or work on the original drivetrain if you like old school.
- A/C installation: Air conditioning for your classic, so you can cruise on a Texas summer night.
- Concourse Trim: Trim and molding restoration. One customer brought in scratched, dull windshield molding and got it back with a mirror finish.

## FAQ
Q: How do you plan a restoration?
A: We sit down with you to build a detailed list of expectations, match it to a budget and let you set your own deadline.

Q: Do you sell finished cars?
A: Yes. The showroom stocks over 65 automobiles and trucks from the 40's through the 90's, including American Muscle, Classics, Street Rods and select Classic Imports.

Q: Can I come see the showroom?
A: Call us to make an appointment to view the showroom.

Q: Do you sell classic parts?
A: Yes. We have a classic parts department to help with your own project.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're 13 miles north of downtown Fort Worth on Golden Triangle Blvd, in a 45,000 square foot building with a large workshop.
